rca_of_issue: Root cause was that POST /api/scans awaited a synchronous GPT-5.4 call inside create_scan (10-14s), and the frontend awaited this response before router.push to /scan-report. From the user's perspective, tapping the workflow appeared to do nothing — the sweep completed but the screen sat on 98% for many seconds and if GPT failed the navigation never happened. FIX (verified): (1) backend create_scan writes doc immediately with ai_report='' and returns {id}; (2) new POST /scans/{id}/analyze does the GPT call and persists ai_report (idempotent — returns cached on 2nd call); (3) advanced-scan.tsx finish() runs runScan (create-only) and calls router.push('/scan-report?id=...') within ~2s; (4) scan-report.tsx auto-invokes analyze on focus, shows scan-ai-loading spinner, then scan-ai text, or scan-ai-retry on failure. Verified via 14 backend pytest + full mobile UI flow: quick workflow reached /scan-report in 2.28s and populated AI in ~30s; full workflow in 5.08s. Regression clean.
